title: GitLab + Bitbucket integration — extend beyond GitHub-only PR creation
description: The merge/create-pr phase only supports GitHub. Add GitLab merge request and Bitbucket pull request creation so TeamAI can be used with any major Git hosting platform. This directly capitalizes on a gap Copilot Workspace cannot fill.
competitiveContext: Copilot Workspace is GitHub-only. This is the single biggest market gap — teams on GitLab/Bitbucket have no spec-driven AI PR tool.
